On Robinhood Chain, every new coin is a gift at the gate. Troya opens it before you do, and an agent you control works from the inside. Before a swap is shown, and again before the Agent Wallet signs, Troya Gate reads seven things: route, price impact, depth, fees, a simulation, a test sell and transfer tax. Fail one, no order. It runs again when you press Confirm, and whatever happens next is written to your journal.

Paste a coin in a private chat with @TrojanTroya_bot, or tap Trade in Telegram on a Sentry post. /long, /short, /close or plain words like "long ETH ${0} at 3x". The Gate runs first, Buy only appears when it passes, and nothing goes through until you tap Confirm. It trades from your Agent Wallet, inside your caps.

Point at a token, a pool or a perp and ask. Live numbers (price, depth, funding, your balances) plus a contract risk read, in whatever language you typed. The chat remembers the conversation, and New chat keeps old ones in an archive you can reopen.
